Therefore the two components are connected with a dot, giving the target SMILES.

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: First transcribe the non-arrow chemical graph from the image. Encode the thioglycolic-acid fragment as O=C(O)CS. Then encode the dinitro aryl sulfonamide fragment by starting at the sulfonamide nitrogen with two wildcard R substituents, *N(*), attaching it to S(=O)(=O), then to the benzene ring with the two nitro substituents in the positions shown: S(=O)(=O)c1ccc(N(O)O)cc1N(O)O. Join the two disconnected components with a dot, yielding *N(*)S(=O)(=O)c1ccc(N(O)O)cc1N(O)O.O=C(O)CS.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中上方是一个含巯基的羧酸片段，可读为 HS-CH2-CO2H；下方是一个苯环，苯环顶部连接 SO2NR1R2，右上邻位有一个 NO2，底部对位有一个 NO2。图中还有从硫附近指向芳环的弯箭头，但题目要求忽略箭头。推理：忽略箭头后，结构包含两个未共价连接的组分。巯基乙酸片段按指定方式编码为 O=C(O)CS。芳基磺酰胺片段从带两个 R 取代基的磺酰胺氮开始，用两个通配符表示 R1 和 R2，写作 *N(*)，再连接 S(=O)(=O)，再连接到二硝基苯环；两个 NO2 按图中位置编码为 c1ccc(N(O)O)cc1N(O)O。因此两个组分用点号连接，得到目标 SMILES。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Direct structure-to-SMILES transcription is the single natural route: identify each disconnected molecular component in the drawing and encode the substituent pattern while deliberately omitting curved-arrow information.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the drawing as two disconnected structures: thioglycolic acid/mercaptoacetic acid shown as H-S-CH2-CO2H with a sulfur lone pair, and an aromatic benzene ring bearing an SO2NR1R2 substituent plus two NO2 substituents. Note the aryl sulfonamide has S double-bonded to two oxygens and single-bonded to the ring and to NR1R2; R1 and R2 are unspecified groups. Ignore the curved arrow from sulfur toward the ring because the prompt says to ignore arrows.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question instruction to output a SMILES expression for the transition-state structure and specifically to ignore arrows, so only atoms and bonds in the drawn structures are encoded.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use SMILES conventions: disconnected fragments are separated by '.', unspecified R groups can be represented as wildcard atoms '*' attached to N, sulfonamide is encoded as *N(*)S(=O)(=O)-aryl, nitro groups may be written in the neutral valence form N(O)O as expected here, and carboxylic acid thiol fragment HSCH2CO2H can be written as O=C(O)CS. Preserve the benzene substitution pattern from the image to form c1ccc(N(O)O)cc1N(O)O attached to the sulfonyl group.
